out.title: Persistent's takeover offer for Nagarro successful; 83.25% secured
out.summary: Persistent's voluntary takeover offer for Nagarro SE succeeded: 61.15% tendered plus 22.10% from Lantano, totaling 83.25%. Additional acceptance period runs September 23–October 6, 2026 at EUR 81.00/share; delisting intended, closing expected end Q1 CY27.
